user.title: Connect to your Reolink NVR or camera
user.description: Uses the Reolink Baichuan protocol (port 9000 by default) for two-way talk. Channels, names and talk support are discovered automatically; setup only makes read-only queries.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the NVR, or of a standalone camera.
data_description.port: TCP port of the Baichuan service (9000 unless you changed it on the device).
data_description.username: A Reolink user on the device. It needs permission to use two-way talk.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: {host} rejected the stored credentials. Enter them again.

data_description.username: A Reolink user on the device.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure the connection
reconfigure.description: Change the address, port or credentials. Leave the password empty to keep the current one.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the NVR, or of a standalone camera.
data_description.port: TCP port of the Baichuan service (9000 unless you changed it on the device).
data_description.username: A Reolink user on the device.
data_description.password: Leave empty to keep the stored password.

error.no_talk_channels: Connected, but every channel reports that it has no two-way talk support.

abort.wrong_device: The address now points to a different Reolink device. Add it as a new device instead.

init.title: Advanced Reolink Card options
init.description: Channels, their state and talk support were re-scanned (read-only) when this dialog opened. Sleeping battery cameras are listed and are woken up when they need to speak. Channels without talk support: {unsupported}.

data.live_talk_non_admin: Allow non-admin users to use live talk

data_description.voice: Any Microsoft Edge neural voice name, for example en-US-JennyNeural or en-GB-RyanNeural.
data_description.volume: 100 % plays the audio unchanged; above 100 % amplifies (may clip).
data_description.enabled_channels: Speaker entities are created only for these cameras, and the actions refuse every other one.
data_description.live_talk_non_admin: Live push-to-talk from the Advanced Reolink Card is limited to administrators unless this is on.
data_description.configure_patrol: Next, pick a PTZ camera and set its sweep arc and patrol defaults.

patrol_camera.title: Camera patrol
patrol_camera.description: Only PTZ cameras are listed. Pick the camera to configure.

patrol_settings.title: Patrol settings: {camera}
patrol_settings.description: Defaults for start_patrol on {camera} (channel {channel}). Values given in an action call override these. Arc times are seconds of panning at the speed below, measured from the guard (home) position. Set both left and right to 0 for a full-range sweep.

data.settle_time: Settle time after going to guard

data_description.enabled: When off, start_patrol refuses this camera.
data_description.left_time: Seconds of left pan from guard to the left limit. The camera never pans past it.
data_description.right_time: Seconds of right pan from guard to the right limit.
data_description.speed: 1-64. The arc times are measured at this speed; changing it changes the arc.
data_description.tilt_levels: Number of tilt rows. 1 keeps the current tilt.
data_description.tilt_step: Seconds of Down tilt between rows.

error.patrol_value_range: A value is outside its allowed range.
error.patrol_arc_incomplete: Set both left and right sweep times, or set both to 0 for a full-range sweep.

abort.no_ptz_channels: This NVR has no PTZ cameras.

invalid_auth.message: The device rejected the stored username or password.

not_a_speaker.message: {entity_id} is not a Advanced Reolink Card speaker.

target_required.message: Pass either a camera (speaker entity) or a channel.

entry_not_loaded.message: The NVR/camera entry {entry_id} does not exist or is not loaded.

no_entry_loaded.message: No Advanced Reolink Card device is set up and loaded.

multiple_entries.message: Several devices are set up: pass a camera or the NVR (config entry) together with the channel.

channel_not_enabled.message: {name} (channel {channel}) is not allowed to talk. Enable it in the integration options.

channel_offline.message: {name} (channel {channel}) is reported offline by the NVR.

talk_timeout.message: {name} (channel {channel}) did not answer in time (it may be asleep or out of Wi-Fi range): {error}

nothing_to_play.message: Nothing to play: pass a message or a media item.

ptz_not_supported.message: {name} (channel {channel}) does not support PTZ, so it cannot patrol.

patrol_not_configured.message: {name} (channel {channel}): mode presets needs a presets list.

patrol_target_required.message: Pass a camera entity, a device, or a channel.

patrol_target_unknown.message: Could not match {target} to an Advanced Reolink Card camera channel.

patrol_disabled.message: Patrol is disabled for {name} (channel {channel}) in the integration options.

patrol_guard_required.message: {name} (channel {channel}) has sweep limits but no guard (home) position set. Set a guard position in the Reolink app first.

patrol_arc_incomplete.message: Set both left_time and right_time (got {left_time} and {right_time}), or both 0 for a full-range sweep.

say.name: Say
say.description: Speak a message on a Reolink camera speaker using edge-tts.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Speaker entity of the camera. Use this or channel.

channel.name: Channel
channel.description: NVR channel number (0-based). Use this or camera.

config_entry_id.name: NVR
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with channel when several NVRs or cameras are set up.

voice.name: Voice
voice.description: edge-tts voice; overrides the default from the options.

play_file.name: Play file
play_file.description: Play an audio file, URL or media-source item (for example a TTS result) on a camera speaker.

media_content_id.name: Media
media_content_id.description: media-source:// ID, http(s) URL, or a local path inside allowlist_external_dirs.

start_patrol.name: Start camera patrol
start_patrol.description: Patrol a PTZ camera: its built-in cruise, a preset tour, or (with no presets) a timed sweep, either across an arc around the guard position (left/right times) or the full pan range. Unset options use the camera's patrol settings, then the built-in defaults. Returns home or to the guard position at the end.

camera.name: Camera
camera.description: Our speaker or a core Reolink camera entity.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: Our camera device or a core Reolink camera device.

config_entry_id.name: NVR
config_entry_id.description: Only needed with channel when several NVRs are set up.

patrol_id.name: Patrol id
patrol_id.description: Built-in Reolink patrol id or name. Used when presets is not set.

presets.name: Presets
presets.description: List of preset names or ids for a software patrol (ToPos).

dwell.name: Dwell
dwell.description: Seconds to wait at each preset (software patrol). Default 10.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: Stop after this many seconds, then return home.

loops.name: Loops
loops.description: How many full preset cycles (software patrol).

return_preset.name: Return preset
return_preset.description: Preset to go to when finished. If omitted, uses the guard position when configured.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: auto (default): presets if given, else the camera's enabled patrol, else a sweep. Or force native, presets or sweep.

sweep_time.name: Sweep time
sweep_time.description: Seconds per full-range pass. Used only when the camera has no arc limits.

pause.name: Pause
pause.description: Seconds to hold at each end of a sweep. Default 2.

speed.name: Speed
speed.description: PTZ speed 1-64 for sweep moves. Default 32.

tilt_levels.name: Tilt levels
tilt_levels.description: Number of sweep passes at different tilts. Default 1 (no tilt change).

tilt_step.name: Tilt step
tilt_step.description: Seconds to tilt down between tilt levels. Default 2.

disable_tracking.name: Pause auto-tracking
disable_tracking.description: Turn auto-tracking off during the sweep and restore it afterwards. Changes a camera setting temporarily.

left_time.name: Left time
left_time.description: Seconds of left pan from guard (arc sweep). Overrides the camera setting.

right_time.name: Right time
right_time.description: Seconds of right pan from guard (arc sweep). Overrides the camera setting.

settle_time.name: Settle time
settle_time.description: Seconds to wait after going to guard before an arc sweep.

stop_patrol.name: Stop camera patrol
stop_patrol.description: Cancel a software patrol and/or send StopPatrol to the camera.

set_patrol_limits.name: Set camera patrol limits
set_patrol_limits.description: Save a PTZ camera's patrol settings (the same as Configure). Only the fields given change. Times of 0 for both left and right clear the arc.
